rationale: EXTREME regime: 61T 55.7%WR +$3.31/7d is our proven edge. NORMAL: 48T 41.7%WR -$0.91 is our drag. Currently all signals use same confidence regardless of regime. Adding regime-specific confidence multiplier would amplify edge in EXTREME (where we win) and reduce entries in NORMAL (where we lose).
implementation: Add REGIME_CONFIDENCE_MULTS dict to hermes_constants.py: {EXTREME: 1.15, NORMAL: 0.85, HIGH: 1.0, FLAT: 1.0}. Apply in signal_compactor.py before confidence threshold check.
